_comment: Order store for managing multiple orders. Only ONE order with 'execute: true' and 'success: false' will be executed.

_instructions.execute: Set to true to mark this order for execution
_instructions.success: Automatically set to true after successful execution
_instructions.limit: (Optional) Upper limit price for IPO and IPO-trigger modes
_instructions.time: (Optional) Scheduled execution time in HH:MM or HH:MM:SS format
_instructions.refresh_before: (Optional) Seconds before execution to refresh tokens (default: 20)
_instructions.sell: (Optional) Set to true for sell order, false/omit for buy order
_instructions.skip_first: (Optional) For IPO-trigger mode: skip first ladder level (default: false)
